name: Harmonic dynamic EQ
plain: An audio-style limiter and booster on the guided prediction, per element. Elements much larger than the typical block RMS are turned down, and very small ones are turned up. Elements in the healthy band keep gain exactly 1.
math:
ref=median over blocks of RMS per block (dim 1 for latents). r=|x|/ref.
r>H: gain=1−a·tanh(K(r−H)/(r+ε)). r<L: gain=1+b·tanh((L−r)/L). Clamp gain. x̂←x̂·gain.
label: from code
